title: In vitro testing of guide RNA efficiency for CRISPR-mediated genome editing
author: Srinidhi Holalu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8zshx6e
materials: HiScribe T7 High Yield RNA Synthesis Kit (NEB E2050S)
Use HiScribe T7 High Yield RNA Synthesis Kit (NEB E2050S)
Move the reaction into 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Extract plant genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the plant tissue using the CTAB method or any routine plant DNA extraction protocol you normally employ.

steps.title: Amplify target region by PCR
steps.instruction: Design primers that flank the target PAM site (NGG) and PCR‑amplify a ~500–600 bp fragment of the genomic region of interest.

steps.title: Clean and verify PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR amplicon with a Zymo or Bioneer DNA‑cleanup kit, then Sanger‑sequence the product to confirm the correct gene fragment and to enable later indel screening.

steps.title: Design gRNA oligos and primers
steps.instruction:
Use a CRISPR design tool (e.g., http://crispr.mit.edu/) to select guide sequences. Order two oligos for each guide:
- Primer 1 (guide‑specific): TAATACGACTCCTATAGGG‑<20 bp guide>‑gtttAagagctaTGCTGgaa (the three bold G’s are required for transcription; if the guide starts with G’s, the same number may be omitted).
- Primer 2 (constant reverse template): aaaagcaccgactcggtgccactttttcaagttgataacggactagccttatttAaacttgctaTGCTGtttcCAGCAtagctctTaaac.

steps.title: In vitro transcribe gRNA
steps.instruction: Set up a 15 µL T7 transcription reaction containing 7 µL nuclease‑free water, 5 µL 10 mM each NTP mix, 2 µL template DNA (≈100–500 ng), and 1 µL T7 RNA polymerase mix. Incubate at 37 °C for 2 h. Add 435 µL nuclease‑free water, measure the RNA concentration on a NanoDrop (note possible NTP interference), optionally clean up with an RNA‑cleanup kit, and dilute the gRNA to 10 ng/µL with water.

substeps.instruction: Mix water, NTPs, template DNA and T7 polymerase as specified.
Add 435 µL nuclease‑free water to the reaction.
Measure concentration on a NanoDrop; record the value.
If desired, perform an RNA cleanup and dilute to 10 ng/µL.

steps.title: Amplify gRNA template by PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL PCR using 30.5 µL nuclease‑free water, 10 µL 5× Phusion buffer, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 4 µL Primer 1 (10 µM), 4 µL Primer 2 (10 µM), and 0.5 µL Phusion polymerase. Run the program: 98 °C 1 min; 98 °C 30 s; 55 °C 15 s; repeat 8–10 cycles; 72 °C 1 min; 72 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C. Quantify the product on a NanoDrop, run a small aliquot on a ≥3 % agarose gel (expected band ≈90 bp), and purify the PCR product with a Zymo/Bioneer DNA‑cleanup kit.

substeps.instruction: Combine reagents to a total volume of 50 µL.
After PCR, measure DNA concentration with a NanoDrop.
Run a portion on a ≥3 % agarose gel to verify a ~90 bp band.
Purify the verified product using a DNA‑cleanup kit.

steps.title: Set up Cas9 cleavage assay
steps.instruction: In a 11 µL reaction mix add 7.5 µL nuclease‑free water, 1.5 µL 10× Cas9 reaction buffer, 1.5 µL 300 nM sgRNA (10 ng/µL), and 0.5 µL Cas9 nuclease. Then add 4 µL substrate DNA (≈50–100 ng). Incubate at 37 °C for 1 h (up to 1.5 h), followed by denaturation at 80 °C for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 37 °C for 1 h (or up to 1.5 h).
Denature the reaction at 80 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare control cleavage reaction
steps.instruction: Set up a parallel reaction containing all components of the Cas9 assay except the sgRNA; optionally vary the sgRNA‑to‑Cas9 ratios to assess efficiency.

steps.title: Prepare 1.1% agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a 1.1 % (w/v) agarose gel (by volume) for resolving the cleavage products.

steps.title: Add loading dye and load samples
steps.instruction: Mix each Cas9 reaction with 2 µL loading dye, load the mixtures onto the gel, and if the gel was not pre‑stained, soak it in staining buffer before imaging.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL loading dye to each reaction.
Load the samples into the gel wells.
If needed, soak the gel in staining buffer.

steps.title: Run gel and visualize cleavage
steps.instruction: Run electrophoresis until the DNA ladder resolves, then examine the gel under UV illumination to assess template DNA cleavage.
